notes: Crystal rule. COILED. Gesture: the spoon hand reaches with its dew glinting, then GRABS: the pad cups, the tentacles curl in and the dew flashes, then it relaxes. Every tentacle is a body part ringed by the black outline, crimson in the dark slot, tipped with a white dew bead. Sport: 'Alba', the anthocyanin-free form.
